variants.headline: New settlers land from the ship
variants.body: New settlers have landed from the ship at {district}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: An arrival becomes a colonial beginning
variants.body: The ship in port has brought new settlers who landed at {district}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Newcomers step into the colony's life
variants.body: The district {district} has received new settlers landing from the ship. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
